Hanson & Doremus Investment Management Cut Stake in Vodafone Group Adr (VOD) by $341,062; Stonebridge Capital Advisors Has Raised Its Stake in Nordstrom (JWN) by $300,424
May 20, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Stonebridge Capital Advisors Llc increased its stake in Nordstrom Inc (JWN) by 8.85% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stonebridge Capital Advisors Llc bought 6,392 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.36% with the market. The institutional investor held 78,633 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.73M, up from 72,241 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stonebridge Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Nordstrom Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.61 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 10.90% or $5.55 during the last trading session, reaching $45.36. About 11.42 million shares traded or 506.64% up from the average. Nordstrom, Inc. (NYSE:JWN) has risen 11.56% since May 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.01% the S&P500.
Hanson & Doremus Investment Management decreased its stake in Vodafone Group Adr (VOD) by 12.29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hanson & Doremus Investment Management sold 11,002 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.40% with the market. The institutional investor held 78,508 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.50 million, down from 89,510 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hanson & Doremus Investment Management who had been investing in Vodafone Group Adr for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $69.74B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.75% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $26.41. About 5.44M shares traded or 73.60% up from the average. Vodafone Group Plc (NASDAQ:VOD) has risen 2.53% since May 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.02% the S&P500.
